newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Q3 invest banking revs 3rd best ever.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Q3 invest banking revs 3rd best ever.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said continued strength in its mergers and acquisitions business helped the firm post the third highest quarterly investment banking revenues in its history.

Morgan Stanley's investment banking revenues totalled $431 million in the just-concluded third quarter and the company said it remained the top ranked firm in terms of announced merger and acquisition transactions through August 31.
The investment banking revenues exceeded by more than 20 percent last year's $355 million, but slipped by about 20 percent from the second quarter's record $542 million.
Last year's fourth quarter ranks as second best, with $503 million in investment banking revenues.

The company's bottom line earnings of $1.27 per share essentially matched Wall Street estimates and were likely to draw "only a limited market reaction," said Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer in a research note.
Soifer, who raised his fourth quarter earnings estimate on Morgan Stanley to $1.41 per share from $1.38, said he continues to rate the shares market perform/hold.

"If our generally optimistic near-term outlook for the debt and equity markets turns out to be correct, Morgan Stanley's share price will probably do well in the next two months as other analysts increase their estimates," he said.

Analysts had generally expected the tumultuous summer market to cut into revenues at firms across the industry, and Morgan alluded to several business lines, such as sales and trading that saw downturns during the third quarter.

"The slow summer months coupled with higher inflation concerns contributed to period of lower volatility during the quarter and to lower trading volumes than in the first two quarters of 1996," the company said in a statement.
Trading revenues totalled $427 million, up from $352 million a year ago but down from $565 million in the second quarter.
Shares in Morgan Stanley rose 1/2 to 51-3/4.
